about_the_game:
In the demo version, you control the main character, "a doll with someone's soul in it", and aim to escape from the roaming clowns, which is the basic game experience of this title. The game experience can be played.

Collect 'memories of innocent souls' scattered around the abandoned school and aim to escape from the abandoned school.

*Please note that save data cannot be transferred to the full version.

・In the demo version, the abandoned school is structured on one level and each environment, such as classrooms, is fixed.

（In the full version, the school is a multi-layered structure and each environment is randomly assigned each time you play the game.)

・In the demo version, only some of the items that support clowns and escape will be implemented.

(In the production version, new clowns and support items will be implemented.)

・The new environment and a story that deepens your understanding of the world of the game will also be implemented in the commercial version.

About the game BugBunny: Discontroll is a survival horror adventure in which you control a "doll with someone's soul" trapped in a nightmarish abandoned school in a unique way and try to escape while running from roaming clowns.

[Features of the game].

🔷 Unique operability

Because they are puppets, they are unable to move as intended.

This sequence generates urgency and apprehension throughout the escape, establishing a distinctive tension that characterises the film.

🔷 Running away, hiding, inspiration.

Avoid the clowns by using situational manoeuvres, such as hiding under lockers and desks, or using items to evade pursuit.

To reach the exit.

🔷 Escape from an abandoned school by collecting "memories".

Dotted around the school「Innocent Memory」

Collecting these will surely provide clues to escape.

Can you escape the clowns' pursuit and collect all the souls?

　

【Recommended for】

People who like unusual operating experiences and unique controls.

People who want to enjoy psychologically chilling horror stories.

People who want to feel a sense of achievement by overcoming difficulties.

People who like to play repetitive, truth-seeking games.
